brief:
Actress Nadia Sawalha has claimed she was taken off air from ITV's "Loose Women" over her position on Gaza, according to Zeteo. In the premiere of the podcast "Sangita Meets…," Sawalha discussed her removal from the daytime show and her anti-Zionist views with host Sangita Myska.

Sawalha said she followed her "moral compass" in taking her stance, though she did not detail the specific circumstances or timeline of her departure from the long-running panel show.
dek: In the premiere of Zeteo UK’s podcast, ‘Sangita Meets…’, actress Nadia Sawalha talks to Sangita Myska about being taken off ITV’s ‘Loose Women’, her anti-Zionism, and following her ‘moral compass’.
title: British TV Host Says Network Removed Her Over Gaza Stance
